title: This trader scalps SPX options in seconds
summary: Eddie Lee (New Brunswick, Canada) pitches discretionary intraday scalping of directional SPX calls/puts: buy ATM (~0.54 delta), analyze on 5-min and execute on a 30-sec chart using EMA 8/21, VWAP, volume-by-price, and Fibonacci, then hold seconds-to-minutes to extract 50 cents-$2 per contract off one-to-three momentum candles, exiting by hotkey with no firm stop. The edge is un-specifiable reaction speed and screen-reading feel, not a rule, so nothing is mechanically reproducible or falsifiable. Claimed returns (100-200%/month in 2020-21, a one-month self-entered Tradezella journal of 77.94% win / PF 1.36 / +$19,211, '2,000% since 2018') are self-reported, blended across strategies, from a vanished regime, or arithmetically inflated (the $19,211 he calls '300%' is ~192%), with no separable brokerage track record and a paid-course sale motive. More honest than the channel norm about difficulty (rates it 10/10 for beginners, 3-5 years to consistency), but fundamentally untestable on our EOD data and untestable in principle. Write-up: strategies/spx_scalping.md (conviction 1.5/5).
